text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle and I are on the way home from an outing when we decide to stop by the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What's that sign say, Trainer? "Rif"… "Ruffle"?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like there's a raffle going on.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: You two over there! Care to try your luck?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wow! So this is what a Japanese raffle looks like! I've been itchin' to try one!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's check it out, Trainer! We could win ourselves somethin' big!
choice_data_list: We have to buy something to get a raffle ticket.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oops, I clean forgot about that part! Let's see… What should I buy?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All right, I've got just the thing! I'm gonna buy me a jug o' milk!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And so, we receive one raffle ticket.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: We've only got one chance! Sure seems like a long shot…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But I'm still gunnin' for the top prize!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! C'mooon, grand-prize!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki pumps herself up and gives the raffle spinner an enthusiastic whirl.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the spinner's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeehaaaw! Now this has made my day!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I did it, Trainer! So when are we goin'?
choice_data_list: Y-you want to go with me?
Y-you want to go with me?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well, of course! We're in this together!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: When do ya wanna head out? Maybe tomorrow—or the day after that? Or how 'bout right now?! 'Kay, let's pack our things and go!
choice_data_list: H-hold on! Let's save it for later!
H-hold on! Let's save it for later!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Later, huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Are you sayin' I haven't worked hard enough to go to a hot spring yet?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And it's a waste to go when you're not tuckered out? That's some true Japanese spirit right there!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okay, I got ya! Let's go when the time is right! It's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It would be nice to use the trip as a reward once she reaches a milestone…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that in mind, I decide to hold on to her ticket for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Nooo! I was so close!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But this big ol' hamburger steak does look packed full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Plus, huge slabs of meat remind me of my family back home!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, we oughta take a picture so I can show my folks what I won!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Get over here, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Say cheese!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, Taiki Shuttle wolfs down the deluxe hamburger steak and fills up with enough energy to last into the next day.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ooh, we almost had it! Drat!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But, these carrots are so shiny—they look delicious!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Since we got so many, what say we invite everybody in the dorm over for a big ol' barbecue?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm sure it'll be a hoot! Let's go right now and get started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night, everyone thoroughly enjoys themselves at the carrot-centric barbecue.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Aww! Third-prize?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Urgh… That don't mean I gotta like it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okay, here's what we're gonna do! We're gonna keep on shoppin' till we get another ticket!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It won't be cheap, but I need that grand-prize… Heck, I'll even make do with first or second!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I talk Taiki Shuttle out of her raffle fervor and half drag her back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oof… This raffle's pretty rough. I guess life ain't all sunshine and rainbows, huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So this is how my first raffle ends…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I join Taiki Shuttle in her disappointment…
